### F64 Drive Overtemp
The F64 fault indicates the drive's internal heatsink temperature has exceeded its safe operating limit (typically around 85°C to 100°C depending on the frame size).

**Diagnostic Approach:**
1. Check the drive's cooling fans. Are they spinning? Are they caked in dust? Many PowerFlex drives have easily replaceable fan modules.
